verdict.rationale: Scaling across nodes is a fair question for a semantic search runtime, but the evidence never documents sharding, clustering, or multi-node distributed deployment. Running on browser, device, or cloud, syncing local sessions to the cloud, and loading several indexes for one query are related deployment and retrieval features, not horizontal scale-out of an index across nodes.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can scale beyond one node with sharding or distributed deployment
